body:
I will begin by saying that I found out about my addictive personality a little too late.  I have been using and abusing alcohol since I was 17 years old.  I am 32 now.  It was not until I was 20 that I did that first 'bump' of coke.  Big mistake.  Now I have develop a methodology to get away with getting messed up everyday.  Everyday after work I go and start having shots of scotch.  I also have a few beers to go with it and then is when the phone calls are made and I begin snorting.  There have been times I can swear I hear my heart's valves just flapping.
There is absolutely no way I can put that bag down once I start and when I get really high, I keep wanting more until it's all gone.  Then I take one half of a Xanax bar to be able to go to sleep.  I do it with company, bymyself, it doesn't matter.  I have easily wasted more than 10,000 from June of last year and I dont care.  I just keep escaping reality.  I am in trouble with this substance.  I suggest if you have not tried it, think about it carefully.  It is simply not worth it.  I PROMISE! I
